name: subarr
description: The coordination layer for the *arr subtitle stack. Subarr stands beside Bazarr, never instead of it: Bazarr finds and downloads, subgen transcribes, and subarr coordinates. It decides what subtitles are actually missing across Sonarr/Radarr/Bazarr per language, keeps a provenance ledger, schedules Whisper walks with backpressure, and verifies the spoken audio language by ear (it tells a mislabeled track from a bilingual one from "genuinely unsure", with one-click fixes that flow back into coverage). A built-in Tuning Lab finds the Whisper settings that win on your hardware. REQUIRES a subgen container for transcription (ghcr.io/coaxk/subarr-subgen recommended; vanilla mccloudS/subgen works in compat mode). Benefits from Bazarr plus Sonarr/Radarr, and optionally Tautulli, Plex, and Ollama. The onboarding wizard auto-detects these on your Docker network on first run at the WebUI; manual entry is available at every step. Subarr itself is CPU-only, no GPU required (that is subgen's job). First run: open the WebUI and complete the onboarding wizard. Anonymous telemetry is on by default; opt out in one click in the wizard or in Settings.

paths.name: Config (appdata)
paths.description: Stores the SQLite database (subarr.db) and persisted settings. The SUBARR_DB_PATH variable below points the DB into this folder.

paths.name: Media Library
paths.description: Your media root. MUST be the same path Bazarr and subgen see. Switch Mode to read-only and set SUBARR_SIDECAR_RENAME=0 if you do not want subarr writing sidecars.

paths.name: Docker Socket (optional, auto-discovery)
paths.description: OPTIONAL. Read-only Docker access lets the onboarding wizard auto-detect your arr stack. Prefer pointing SUBARR_DOCKER_PROXY_URL at a tecnativa docker-socket-proxy instead of mounting the raw socket. Leave blank if you enter integration URLs manually.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Web interface / API port. If you change this, also set the SUBARR_PORT variable below to match.

variables.name: SUBARR_PORT
variables.description: Port the app listens on inside the container. Keep equal to the WebUI host port mapping above.

variables.name: SUBARR_DB_PATH
variables.description: SQLite path. Must live inside the Config (appdata) volume above.

variables.name: SUBARR_MEDIA_ROOT
variables.description: Container path of the media root (matches the Media Library path target above).

variables.name: SUBGEN_URL
variables.description: Base URL of your subgen container's API. Default assumes a container named 'subgen' on the same Docker network.

variables.name: SUBGEN_CONTAINER
variables.description: Name of the subgen container (used for log/restart actions from the UI).

variables.name: TAUTULLI_URL
variables.description: Optional. e.g. http://tautulli:8181 - adds playback-priority signal.

variables.name: PLEX_URL
variables.description: Optional. e.g. http://192.168.1.10:32400 - enables instant library refresh on sub write.

variables.name: OLLAMA_URL
variables.description: Optional. e.g. http://ollama:11434 - enables language enrichment + vision pre-filter.

variables.name: SUBARR_DOCKER_PROXY_URL
variables.description: Optional. URL of a tecnativa docker-socket-proxy for read-only auto-discovery (preferred over mounting the raw socket).

variables.name: SUBARR_USER
variables.description: Optional. HTTP Basic auth user (single-admin fallback; prefer a reverse proxy).
